doc: Metric definitions with explicit numerators, denominators and units. A metric whose denominator changes becomes a new versioned metric; it is never a silent correction of history. Zero denominators produce a typed unavailable result, never NaN, infinity or a fabricated zero.

verified_throughput.vendor_tokens.numerator: sum of frozen weights of unique accepted work units in the measurement window
verified_throughput.vendor_tokens.denominator: admissible observed vendor tokens in the same window
verified_throughput.vendor_tokens.note: An observed zero-token local operation may be labelled token-free for that measured scope. Unmetered surrounding model work is not thereby free.

time_throughput.active_elapsed.numerator: sum of frozen weights of unique accepted work units
time_throughput.active_elapsed.denominator: active elapsed execution time (union of active intervals in one clock domain)

effort_throughput.numerator: sum of frozen weights of unique accepted work units
effort_throughput.denominator: aggregate effort (sum of non-overlapping leaf actor spans)
effort_throughput.note: Published alongside active elapsed time, never instead of it.

tool_leverage.cohortAggregation: aggregate matched resources, not the unweighted mean of per-pair ratios

rework_tax.vendor_tokens.note: Published separately per unit domain. Dividing tokens by time is rejected rather than reported.

first_pass_yield.numerator: unique submissions accepted on their first qualifying attempt
first_pass_yield.denominator: unique submissions in the frozen cohort

continuity_retention.numerator: required handoff facts restored with admissible provenance

mixedCounterWarnings: Skill uses, implementation runs and tool invocations are separate counters. The historical 227/508 concentration ratio mixed them; do not reconstruct a 44.7% figure from those counters.
